Ah, wait! I get it. In snap I was computing `rs=[q[0] for q in n['boundary']]` — the boundary is corner points, and for a 6x6 square the boundary is [(18,11),(18,16),(23,16),(23,11)] or similar. min(rs)=18, max=23. That should output (18,23). But it output (56,61).
Hmm, unless the frame at the time of snap was different. Wait — snap ran right after action(['ACTION7']). So ACTION7 with the beam retracted = no visible change. Next: try ACTION7 with the beam extended into R (tip 22). Let's do RIGHT then ACTION7.

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def board_state():
    f=current_frame
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']>=16 and n['color'] in 'MRNb' and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    lines=f.ascii.splitlines(); cells=[]
    for r in range(12,42):
        for c in range(17,47):
            if lines[r][c] in 'wg': cells.append((r,c))
    out['beam']=(min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells),min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)) if cells else None
    return out

print('before:',board_state())
r=action(['RIGHT'])
print('after RIGHT:',board_state(),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','board_changed')})
if not last_action_result.get('no_impact'):
    r=action(['ACTION7'])
    print('after ACTION7(tip22):',board_state(),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','board_changed','level_completed','done','score')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
